base:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent 2D game animation sheet, character body layer only, 12 separate complete full-body drawings.
Reference 1 defines adult Oichi's identity/outfit, reference 2 defines desired high definition painted arcade line art, dimensional shading and crisp outlines. Redraw Oichi to that same formal enemy art style while preserving her mature beautiful adult face, slim graceful legs, slender athletic proportions, long black high ponytail with simple small gold-red hairpin, white sleeveless crossed kimono top trimmed red, short red pleated battle skirt and wide red obi, dark forearm guards, white tabi and red sandals. White athletic cycling shorts worn under her red skirt for combat coverage. Normal anatomical proportions, adult woman age 28, not chibi.
CRITICAL body-only layers for interchangeable longbow: NO BOW, NO ARROW, NO SWORD, NO weapon, NO quiver, NO weapon-shaped marks baked into these sprites. A longbow will be rendered on her back by the game. Keep back and hands available. Hair remains flowing visibly separate from body.
actions: run

Six phases of RUNNING to the right, torso leaning slightly forward: left leg far forward, left planted/right knee passing, right knee lifted, right leg extended far forward, right planted/left passing, left knee lifted. Alternate wide and narrow foot spacing clearly. Hair streams backward. Hands ready at waist. Both feet airborne in passing phase. Not a held lunge.
light1

First quick NEEDLE THROW attack: 1 right forearm tucked at belt, 2 right elbow draws back, 3 torso twists forward, 4 right arm flicks forward at chest height with open fingers, 5 wrist follows through, 6 resets. Left arm balances, knees flex. Do not draw needles or any weapons; game projectiles supplied separately. Every pose faces generally right.
light2

Second quick NEEDLE THROW combo: six poses of an underhand-to-overhand backhand toss with left lead step, from right hand low by hip, through diagonal forward-up swinging arm, high extended release to RIGHT, broad twisting follow-through, and recoil. Visibly different from first chest-height throw. No weapons or needles baked into hands.
heavy2

Second longbow volley BODY LAYER: six phases starting semi-crouched with left fist forward, rising into broad sideways stance, left arm fully extended to RIGHT slightly angled upward, right fingers draw to cheek, right elbow snaps backward in release, then left arm lowers. Hands must be clearly visible, no bow/string/arrows drawn, separate game layers. More forceful than normal shot.
charged_upper

High-angle single freezing arrow BODY LAYER: six continuous poses from raising empty left fist diagonally forward-up, right hand draws toward cheek, left arm fully extended upward 40 degrees to RIGHT, strained full draw, open release hand, finish low stance with raised left fist. Draw no bow or arrow; game adds them at hand anchors.
charged_slam

Powerful forward ice-wave plus three-arrow body choreography: six full-body poses. 1 low crouch knees bent shoulders coiled both fists close chest, 2 turn hips into wide stance left fist forward right hand to cheek, 3 full draw as left arm extends straight toward RIGHT chest high and right hand pulled back, 4 release with dramatic left lunge, 5 sweep left fist downward and torso follows, 6 settled crouch. No VFX or weapon in image, game adds bow/arrows/ice. Keep hands readable.
air_light

Six poses airborne NEEDLE THROW, adult acrobatic fighter with practical fully covering sports shorts: leap knee up, torso twist, right arm flicks forward-down, open release fingers, arms balance, descent knees soften. Figure in each own cell same anatomical scale. No weapon or projectiles, feet not anchored to imagined ground.
air_heavy

Six AIRBORNE ARCHERY poses, rightward jump then left empty fist extends right-down while right fingers pull to cheek, hold, release, followthrough, lower arms preparing landing. No bow/arrows/string baked in body. Figure same anatomical scale; natural arched torso and bent knees. Fully covering white athletic shorts.
rising

Six rising needle throw/uppercut motion body poses, low coiled stance, right elbow pulled back, right forearm rises strongly up-right, release fingers high, torso stretch, recovery. Keep same actor and separate cells. No weapon and no VFX.
low_sweep

Six low sweeping needle attack body poses: lower center of gravity, bend leading knee, twist shoulder low, sweep right forearm parallel to ground from left to RIGHT at knee height, low outstretched release, gather back. A low grounded action with skirt and ponytail swinging. No weapon or projectile. Practical sports shorts fully cover hips and upper thighs.
dash_heavy

Six horizontal longbow BASH body poses: launch step forward, both fists set horizontally across waist 55cm apart, torso rotates, both arms drive horizontally toward RIGHT as if holding a staff, shoulders continue sweep, recover wide stance. Draw NO bow/staff/weapon at all, just anatomically accurate clenched empty hands marking where game adds the longbow. Clearly a sweeping two-handed strike, not archery drawing.
dash_strike

Six forward lunging needle thrust body poses: low sprint coil, push off back foot, extend right empty hand forward, lunge full extension, forward sliding knee settles, recover. White athletic shorts cover under skirt. No objects/weapons drawn. Distinct whole-body progression with hair trailing.
jump

Six phases of a vertical-forward jump: squat with hips low, push off toes, rising both knees bent, apex knees tucked less, descending legs extend, soft landing knees bend. Neutral open or loose-fist arms balance. No weapons. Same anatomical size, empty background and broad gutters.
hurt

Six consecutive HIT REACTION poses: upright shocked flinch, shoulders hunch forward, waist bends sharply in abdominal pain, eyes squeezed shut and mouth grimaces, one hand clutches abdomen, recovering to half bent stance. Clear pain expression and torso motion, not just swaying. No weapons.
down

Six chronological FALL AND DEATH poses: struck backwards upright, knees buckle and torso pitches sideways, one hand contacts ground, body falls onto side, legs extend along ground, final completely lying flat on side eyes closed legs relaxed and head low. No kneeling end, no standing end. Final two frames are horizontal prone full-body, keep proportional anatomy; no weapons.
recovering

Six GETTING UP poses: begin lying flat on side, plant elbow, raise torso seated one knee bent, plant palm and knee, crouch onto both feet, finish standing ready. Fullbody in each cell at consistent anatomical scale, no duplicates. No weapons.
launched

Six body poses for being knocked airborne: backward arch arms flung, quarter rotation hips raised, horizontal midair body, rotating onto side knees curling, feet dropping, brace for landing. Same fullbody proportions. No weapon/impact effect. All inside separate cells with huge horizontal clearance.
stunned

Six dizzy stagger poses on feet: shoulders slump, head tilts right, knees wobble, palm goes to forehead, eyes half-closed face dazed, try straighten. Clearly different arm and body silhouettes but normal anatomical proportions. No weapons.
guard

Six guarding poses using longbow layered later: left forearm raises, both hands bring empty grip positions across body diagonally, firm braced knees, small recoil from impact pushing shoulders back, tighten guard, reset stance. No bow/weapon drawn, both clenched hands visible. Main front fist at chest level.
throw

Six grab and shoulder throw poses with NO opponent: open hands reach forward, seize imaginary lapel at chest, bend knees and rotate hips, pull hands past shoulder, arms extend forward-down releasing, recovery facingright. Dynamic wholebody, no objects or second character. Back-mounted bow separate.
victory

Six confident playful ADULT victory poses: relaxed exhale, turn shoulders toward viewer, sweep long ponytail behind shoulder, place hand on hip, cross one foot elegantly in front of other and smile, finish proud friendly wink and small open-hand greeting. Red skirt and white sleeveless top remain securely covering, no undressing. Graceful posture, shoulder and leg silhouette retain character identity. No weapons drawn; back-mounted bow separate.
